conversion: DOCX to UTF-8 plain text. why: The ACT's general interpretation Act (s 3 (2) (c) (iii) of the Act itself lists 'providing rules about the interpretation of legislation' among the ways its object is to be achieved).

notes: Status on the landing page at retrieval: In Force; current version R126, 23 February 2026; 'Republication for amendments by A2026-4'. The DOCX cover reads Republication No 126, Effective 23 February 2026, Republication date 23 February 2026, Last amendment made by A2026-4.

The landing page's Notes for the current version read 'Uncommenced amendments by Better Regulation Legislation Amendment Act 2026'. The DOCX says uncommenced amending laws are not included in the republished law, and the converted text has no heading marked with the symbol U (uncommenced provision) or M (modification). Nothing was added or removed on account of that note.

Lettered sections present: 2A, 22A, 60A, 65A, 75AA, 75A, 75B, 79A, 84A, 106A, 151A, 151B, 151C, 169A, 169B, 184A, 225A, 225B, 254A. Division 19.3.2A (Standing acting arrangements) is a division number with a letter.

Endnotes: the DOCX has five endnotes (1 About the endnotes, 2 Abbreviation key, 3 Legislation history, 4 Amendment history, 5 Earlier republications). The ACAT Act deposit has a sixth, 'Expired transitional or validating provisions'; this republication has none.

Plain text cannot carry formatting. The DOCX applies a bold-italic character style 1,209 times and an italic one 645 times, and has 2,488 hyperlink elements (cross-references); the words are kept, the formatting and link targets are not. The endnote abbreviation key says underlining marks a provision not commenced or to be expired. The DOCX has no underlined text: the underline character style occurs 21 times, once on the word 'underlining' in that key and 20 times on paragraph marks (not on text) in the 'Earlier republications' table, and the DOCX has no direct underline element; the only other emphasis marks are hyperlink styling and one struck-through space. The converted text contains no mention of the Better Regulation Legislation Amendment Act 2026, and the DOCX's legislation history lists no uncommenced amending law.

Line breaks inside a table cell or inside a legislation-history or amendment-history entry (284 in all, 279 of them in the 'Earlier republications' table) are written as one space. A table cell with several paragraphs is written on one line with the paragraphs separated by one space, so a note inside a cell (in the first table, item 1) stays in that cell.

Tables are written one row per line and the table title (for example 'Table 151 Working out periods of time') is written as an ordinary line above its table. Column headings read as published, including the words 'column 1', 'column 2' and 'column 3'.

Indentation in the text is whitespace only. The nesting indents were set from the ACAT Act deposit paragraph by paragraph; for the 21 paragraphs in five styles the ACAT Act does not use (aExamNumText 5, aExamNumTextss 9, aExamPara 4, AExamIPara 2, Aparareturn 1) they were set by analogy.

Paragraphs that the DOCX leaves in the default paragraph style (no style name) are written at column 0, as in the ACAT Act deposit. Besides the three cover and title lines 'Australian Capital Territory' and the closing '© Australian Capital Territory 2026', they are hypothetical provisions quoted inside examples, which read like real provisions but are not: in the examples to s 6, '(2) The Legislation Act, section 47 (3) does not apply to a regulation under this Act.', '(3) A regulation may apply, adopt or incorporate an instrument ...', '60 Serving notice of annual general meeting' and the sentence under it; in the example to s 75B, '2 Commencement' and 'This Act is taken to have commenced on 17 October 2001.'; in example 2 to s 140, '6 Corresponding law—Act, s 100, def corresponding law'; and in the examples to s 156, 'a—see section 50.' and 'a, for part 6 (Complaints)—see section 50.'

Three images were dropped: the ACT crest on the cover and on two title pages (alt text '[ACT Crest high res small]'). The DOCX holds no equation, formula image or embedded object, so no formula was transcribed.
Word is the only route this deposit used for the text; the authorised PDF was fetched once (2026-11-11T14:22:29Z) only to check completeness and is not redistributed here.

Interpreter: the converter was run with Python 3.13.10 because the default python3 on the machine (3.15.1) fails to import pyexpat; this does not affect the output, which was checked byte for byte against the precedent deposit.
